body:
Hey Avicus players!!
I decided to make a map for you guys!! Maybe you saw Yin Yang which was made by me and Clijmart. Well I enjoyed the building so much I decided to make another map!
Info:
Theme: Orcish
Name: Cruel Darkness
Teams: Skull Smashers vs Bone Breakers

replies.author: W0RD
replies.body: Just one for players to run on. The current map doesn't have you move to much off a straight line, so it would be nice to see them branching off a little. This would not effect the pvp gameplay at the centre but would allow for the players to have a little move choice in where they go.
